# Prepare a driver list and identified CNAs

```{r read data}
all_cancertypes_fct <- read_tsv("../../data/cancertype_fct_v2.tsv", col_names = "cancertype") %>%
  pull(cancertype) %>% 
  intersect(unique(df$cancertype_CCAT))

df_boundaries <- read_tsv("../../data/centromere_boundaries.tsv")

df_CNA <- read_csv("result/1_data_preparation/C_CAT_tissue/merged/merged_CNV_data.csv", na = ".") %>%
  mutate(CNA_type = case_when(
    Alt == "Amplification" ~ str_glue("{Gene} amp"),
    Alt == "Deletion" ~ str_glue("{Gene} del")
  )) %>%
  filter(Tumor_Sample_Barcode %in% df$Tumor_Sample_Barcode) %>% 
  left_join(df_boundaries, by = c("Chrom" = "Chrom")) %>% 
  mutate(arm0 = case_when(
    Pos < boundary ~ "p",
    Pos >= boundary ~ "q"
  )) %>%
  mutate(arm = str_glue("{Chrom}{arm0}"))

df_driverCNA <- read_tsv("result/1_data_preparation/C_CAT_tissue/driver_creation/table/driver_CNA_genes.tsv") 
df_driverCNA_select <- df_driverCNA %>% 
  dplyr::select(CNA_type, arm) %>% 
  distinct()
```

# Univariate analysis

```{r univariate analysis}

EvaluateCNAenrichment <- function(mycancertype, mycolname) {
  # mycancertype <- all_cancertypes_fct[[2]]
  # mycolname <- "Alcohol"
  df_filt <- df %>%
    filter(cancertype_CCAT == mycancertype) 
  samples0 <- df_filt %>%
    filter(!!sym(mycolname) == 0) %>%
    pull(Tumor_Sample_Barcode) %>%
    unique()
  samples1 <- df_filt %>%
    filter(!!sym(mycolname) == 1) %>%
    pull(Tumor_Sample_Barcode) %>%
    unique()
  
  driver_CNAs <- df_driverCNA %>% 
    filter(cancertype == mycancertype) %>% 
    pull(CNA_type)
  
  df_CNA_agg <- tibble(
    CNA_type = driver_CNAs,
    num_alt_0 = NA_real_,
    num_alt_1 = NA_real_,
    num_wt_0 = NA_real_,
    num_wt_1 = NA_real_
  )
  
  for (i in seq_along(driver_CNAs)) {
    CNA_i <- driver_CNAs[i]
    alt_samples0 <- df_CNA %>%
      filter(Tumor_Sample_Barcode %in% samples0, CNA_type == CNA_i) %>%
      pull(Tumor_Sample_Barcode) %>%
      unique()
    alt_samples1 <- df_CNA %>%
      filter(Tumor_Sample_Barcode %in% samples1, CNA_type == CNA_i) %>%
      pull(Tumor_Sample_Barcode) %>%
      unique()
    
    wt_samples0 <- setdiff(samples0, alt_samples0)
    wt_samples1 <- setdiff(samples1, alt_samples1)
    
    df_CNA_agg[i, "num_alt_0"] <- length(alt_samples0)
    df_CNA_agg[i, "num_alt_1"] <- length(alt_samples1)
    df_CNA_agg[i, "num_wt_0"] <- length(wt_samples0)
    df_CNA_agg[i, "num_wt_1"] <- length(wt_samples1)
  }
  
  offset <- 0.01
  df_CNA_fisher_res <- df_CNA_agg %>% 
    mutate(
      fisher_res = pmap(
        list(num_wt_0, num_alt_0, num_wt_1, num_alt_1),
        function(a, b, c, d) {
          mat <- matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2)
          fisher.test(mat)
        }
      ),
      fisher_p = map_dbl(fisher_res, ~ .x$p.value),
      
      fisher_or = pmap_dbl(
        list(num_wt_0, num_alt_0, num_wt_1, num_alt_1),
        function(a, b, c, d) {
          ((a + offset) * (d + offset)) / ((b + offset) * (c + offset))
        }
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-fisher_res) %>%
    mutate(
      cancertype = mycancertype,
      variable = mycolname
    )
  
  return(df_CNA_fisher_res)
}

ls_df_CNA_fisher_smoking <- vector("list", length(all_cancertypes_fct))
ls_df_CNA_fisher_alcohol <- vector("list", length(all_cancertypes_fct))

for (i in seq_along(all_cancertypes_fct)) {
  # i <- 1
  ls_df_CNA_fisher_smoking[[i]] <- EvaluateCNAenrichment(all_cancertypes_fct[[i]], "Smoking")
  ls_df_CNA_fisher_alcohol[[i]] <- EvaluateCNAenrichment(all_cancertypes_fct[[i]], "Alcohol")
}

RenameColnames <- function(ls_df_input, mycolname, terms) {
  # ls_df_input <- ls_df_CNA_fisher_smoking
  # mycolname <- "smoking"
  # terms <- c("never", "ever")
  
  df_input <- bind_rows(ls_df_input) %>%
    mutate(fisher_q_all = p.adjust(fisher_p, method = "BH"))
  
  # Define the new column names to match the required naming
  new_names <- c(
    str_glue("num_samples_alt_{terms[2]}"), # 1 → ever, excessive
    str_glue("num_samples_wt_{terms[2]}"),
    str_glue("num_samples_alt_{terms[1]}"), # 0 → never, non_excessive
    str_glue("num_samples_wt_{terms[1]}"),
    str_glue("fisher_or_{mycolname}"),
    str_glue("fisher_p_{mycolname}"),
    str_glue("fisher_q_all_{mycolname}")
  )
  
  old_names <- c(
    "num_alt_1",
    "num_wt_1",
    "num_alt_0",
    "num_wt_0",
    "fisher_or",
    "fisher_p",
    "fisher_q_all"
  )
  
  df_input2 <- df_input %>% dplyr::rename(!!!setNames(old_names, new_names))
  
  df_input_select <- df_input2 %>%
    dplyr::select(CNA_type, cancertype, all_of(new_names))
  
  return(df_input_select)
}

df_CNA_fisher_smoking <- RenameColnames(ls_df_CNA_fisher_smoking, "smoking", c("never", "ever"))
df_CNA_fisher_alcohol <- RenameColnames(ls_df_CNA_fisher_alcohol, "alcohol", c("non_excessive", "excessive"))

df_CNA_fisher_uni <- df_CNA_fisher_smoking %>%
  left_join(df_CNA_fisher_alcohol, by = c("CNA_type", "cancertype")) 

```

# Univariate analysis, relationship with pack-years

```{r univariate pack-years}
df_CNA_smoking3groups <- df_CNA_fisher_uni %>%
  dplyr::select(CNA_type, cancertype) %>%
  mutate(
    num_samples_alt_gePY20 = NA_real_,
    num_samples_wt_gePY20 = NA_real_,
    num_samples_alt_ltPY20 = NA_real_,
    num_samples_wt_ltPY20 = NA_real_,
    cochran_armitage_pvalue = NA_real_
  )

for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_CNA_smoking3groups))) {
  # i <- 1
  CNAtype_i <- df_CNA_smoking3groups$CNA_type[i]
  cancer_i <- df_CNA_smoking3groups$cancertype[i]
  
  samples_tmp <- df %>%
    filter(cancertype_CCAT == cancer_i) %>%
    pull(Tumor_Sample_Barcode) %>%
    unique()  
  df_CNA_tmp <- df_CNA %>%
    filter(Tumor_Sample_Barcode %in% samples_tmp, CNA_type == CNAtype_i)
  never_samples <- df %>%
    filter(cancertype_CCAT == cancer_i) %>%
    filter(smoking_status_2groups == "Never") %>%
    pull(Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
  more20_samples <- df %>%
    filter(cancertype_CCAT == cancer_i) %>%
    filter(smoking_status_2groups == "Ever") %>%
    filter(packyear >= 20) %>%
    pull(Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
  less20_samples <- df %>%
    filter(cancertype_CCAT == cancer_i) %>%
    filter(smoking_status_2groups == "Ever") %>%
    filter(packyear < 20) %>%
    pull(Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
  alt_never_samples <- df_CNA_tmp %>%
    filter(Tumor_Sample_Barcode %in% never_samples) %>%
    pull(Tumor_Sample_Barcode) %>%
    unique()
  alt_more20_samples <- df_CNA_tmp %>%
    filter(Tumor_Sample_Barcode %in% more20_samples) %>%
    pull(Tumor_Sample_Barcode) %>%
    unique()
  alt_less20_samples <- df_CNA_tmp %>%
    filter(Tumor_Sample_Barcode %in% less20_samples) %>%
    pull(Tumor_Sample_Barcode) %>%
    unique()
  wt_never_samples <- setdiff(never_samples, alt_never_samples)
  wt_more20_samples <- setdiff(more20_samples, alt_more20_samples)
  wt_less20_samples <- setdiff(less20_samples, alt_less20_samples)
  
  df_CNA_smoking3groups[i, "num_samples_alt_gePY20"] <- length(alt_more20_samples)
  df_CNA_smoking3groups[i, "num_samples_wt_gePY20"] <- length(wt_more20_samples)
  df_CNA_smoking3groups[i, "num_samples_alt_ltPY20"] <- length(alt_less20_samples)
  df_CNA_smoking3groups[i, "num_samples_wt_ltPY20"] <- length(wt_less20_samples)
  
  matrix_tmp <- c(
    length(wt_never_samples),
    length(wt_less20_samples),
    length(wt_more20_samples),
    length(alt_never_samples),
    length(alt_less20_samples),
    length(alt_more20_samples)
  ) %>% 
    matrix(nrow = 3)
  
  colnames(matrix_tmp) <- c("Not altered", "Altered")
  rownames(matrix_tmp) <- c("Never", "Less_20", "More_20")
  res <- CochranArmitageTest(matrix_tmp)
  p_value <- res$p.value
  
  df_CNA_smoking3groups[i, "cochran_armitage_pvalue"] <- p_value
}

```

# Multivariate analysis

```{r multivariate analysis}

df_combinations <- df_CNA_fisher_uni %>%
  dplyr::select(CNA_type, cancertype) 

ls_df_res_lm <- vector("list", nrow(df_combinations))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_combinations))) {
  # i <- 255
  CNAtype_i <- df_combinations$CNA_type[i]
  cancer_i <- df_combinations$cancertype[i]
  # CNAtype_i <- "NKX2-1 amp"
  # cancer_i <- "LUSC"
  
  samples_tmp <- df %>%
    filter(cancertype_CCAT == cancer_i) %>%
    pull(Tumor_Sample_Barcode) %>%
    unique()
  
  df_CNA_tmp <- df_CNA %>%
    filter(CNA_type == CNAtype_i) %>%
    filter(Tumor_Sample_Barcode %in% samples_tmp)
  
  df_subset <- df %>%
    mutate(smoking_status_2groups = factor(smoking_status_2groups, levels = c("Never", "Ever"))) %>%
    mutate(alcohol_status = factor(alcohol_status, levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"))) %>%
    filter(cancertype_CCAT == cancer_i) %>%
    mutate(Alteration = if_else(Tumor_Sample_Barcode %in% df_CNA_tmp$Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 1, 0)) 

  model_comb_age <- glm(Alteration ~ smoking_status_2groups + alcohol_status + Age, data = df_subset, family = binomial)

  df_model_comb_age <- broom::tidy(model_comb_age)
  df_row_comb_age <- df_model_comb_age %>% 
    filter(term == "smoking_status_2groupsEver")
  df_alcohol_row_comb_age <- df_model_comb_age %>% 
    filter(term == "alcohol_statusTRUE")
  
  ls_df_res_lm[[i]] <- tibble(
    CNA_type = CNAtype_i,
    cancertype = cancer_i,
    OR_smoking_multivar_alcsmkage = exp(df_row_comb_age$estimate),
    pval_smoking_multivar_alcsmkage = df_row_comb_age$p.value,
    OR_alcohol_multivar_alcsmkage = exp(df_alcohol_row_comb_age$estimate),
    pval_alcohol_multivar_alcsmkage = df_alcohol_row_comb_age$p.value,
  )
}

df_CNA_fisher_multi0 <- bind_rows(ls_df_res_lm)

df_CNA_fisher_multi <- df_CNA_fisher_multi0 %>%
  mutate(
    qval_all_smoking_multivar_alcsmkage = p.adjust(pval_smoking_multivar_alcsmkage, method = "BH"),
    qval_all_alcohol_multivar_alcsmkage = p.adjust(pval_alcohol_multivar_alcsmkage, method = "BH")
  )

df_fisher_merged <- df_CNA_fisher_uni %>%
  left_join(df_CNA_smoking3groups, by = c("CNA_type", "cancertype")) %>%
  left_join(df_CNA_fisher_multi, by = c("cancertype", "CNA_type")) %>% 
  left_join(df_driverCNA_select, by = c("CNA_type" = "CNA_type")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(CNA_type, arm, cancertype, everything())

df_fisher_merged %>% 
  write_tsv(str_glue("{outdir_table}/driver_mutation_enrichment_univariate_multivariate.tsv"))

```
